paper_title: Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time   Scaling
caption: Distribution of Pass@1 accuracy of Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct on MATH-500, divided into five bins.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of Pass@1 accuracy for the Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct model across five bins on the MATH-500 benchmark. The horizontal axis represents the pass rate, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, and is labeled “Pass@1”. The vertical axis represents the percentage of accuracy, ranging from 0.0% to 76.2%, and is labeled “Percentage”. The scale is linear, with tick intervals of 0.1% and 0.2%, and the values are displayed as percentages. The single bar is colored light blue and extends approximately 0.8 units along the horizontal axis, corresponding to approximately 76.2% accuracy, with associated values of 11.2%, 3.4%, 3.4%, and 5.8% shown as text labels below the bar. The bar is not sorted, and it is not visually emphasized in any way.
